message: You are planning a fictional museum reopening. Create exactly three parallel worker roles named worker and one final role named joiner. The joiner must merge the worker outputs into one memo. Facts: reopening date is June 15; staffing is short by 8 docents; HVAC testing finishes in 5 days; donor preview is fixed for June 12; only 2 mitigations can be chosen for the first week; list exactly 3 follow-up checks. Keep the memo under 180 words.
